tools.name: find_agent_apis
tools.description: Search paid CSV, JSON, OpenAPI/API-discovery, calendar, document, invoice, text, and U.S. weather APIs by task. Returns up to five best-matching route URLs, seller prices, categories, and free examples; does not initiate payment.

tools.name: get_agent_api_details
tools.description: Return the request fields, free example, OpenAPI link, seller price, and x402 notes for one API. Does not call the endpoint or initiate payment.

tools.name: find_csv_import_apis
tools.description: Search this service's vendor CSV, preflight, schema validation, typed JSON import, batch import, and recurring CSV monitoring endpoints. Returns route contracts, prices, and free examples without processing CSV data or initiating payment.

tools.name: get_csv_import_api_details
tools.description: Return required and optional request fields, a free example, the OpenAPI specification, and x402 payment notes for one CSV endpoint. Does not call the endpoint or initiate payment.
